items.text: Hello everyone,
This is just a quick announcement that the 1.2 Update, prior accessed via the beta branch, is now live on the default branch. The changelog (mirrored from prior Steam post) can be found below:

A new (optional) third-person camera mode has been added as a New Game+ feature. This mode is available to everyone from the start during the beta test to help with testing; afterward it will be available ONLY after completing the game once.

Many locations have been reworked to accommodate the (optional) third-person view; background décor and visual effects have been added. Please note that some locations will appear in the old cinematic view due to their design.
Polly gets covered in blood and dirt when her health is low.
The mouse aim-assist system has been reworked so players can choose targets more precisely.
An interactive map has been added to the inventory in Episode 4 to make navigation easier.
Almost all enemy i-frames that caused unexpected invulnerability during certain actions have been removed.
The skate throw animation has been slightly sped up to make this attack more useful in combat.
Some enemy attacks can now be interrupted with a skate hit.
Trap bombs (both static and leg-mounted) now explode after two shots instead of four.
Enemy colliders have been tuned more accurately.
In some locations, water reflections are now completely disabled when minimal reflection quality is selected in the settings, to optimize performance.
Localization fixes.
Fixes for some shaders.
Numerous bug fixes, including critical ones related to important loot disappearing.
We hope you enjoy!

items.text: Hi all, as part of our effort to address your feedback and show appreciation for your continued support of SILLY POLLY BEAST, we're happy to say that a new patch is available for the game! This patch continues to builds on some of the more important improvements which were shipped in earlier patches, and smooths out the game behavior further. As you read this, it should shortly become available on the main/default branch.

In addition to fine-tuning the balance and fixing several small issues, this patch sees the addition of a new difficulty mode: Hard+. This mode is a truly difficult option, intended for those who want the hardest challenge possible and to test their skills to the limits!
A new Hard+ mode has been added, in which Polly almost always dies with the first hit. The difficulty cannot be adjusted in this mode due the game.
In Hard+ mode, Polly has a patch on her nose.
Completing the game in this mode awards a small symbolic reward
Steamdeck's default resolution is now set to 1280x720.
Polly now removes her glasses in two cutscenes (if she’s wearing them) to help the player better understand what’s happening.
Added options to set 30/60/120 FPS mode in graphic settings for vsync on/off (by default, vsync is on + 60 fps is set at start-up)
The rain effect in Episode 3 has been improved and optimized.
Enemy magic and physical shields can now be instantly destroyed by throwing the skateboard at them - except when the magic shield is applied by a totem
Slightly reduced incoming damage on Easy and Normal
Reduced enemy invulnerability time during certain actions
Wolf bite damage slightly reduced on Easy and Normal
The width of the platform during the ep4 boss fight on the roof now depends on the difficulty level; the easier the difficulty level, the wider the platform
The damage from stings at the edges of the fog has been rebalanced
Stamina recovers a bit faster
The balancing of the final boss has been improved.
Reduced the minimum size for characters in Polly's speech bubble, in order to avoid clipping of non-latin fonts.
Various localization fixes
Improved collision checking of characters with the world and objects
Raven Totem collider fixed
Fixed collider issues in some locations in Episode 5.

Also, as mentioned prior, we have archived older, pre-balancing builds rather than getting rid of them for those who prefer certain builds. In case you missed it from the last post, the initial release variant of the game can be still accessed via branch password "archivedbuilds" (no quotes). For those who prefer the pre-balance changes of the game, we want to ensure these builds were still accessible. Note we cannot back-patch issues such as TAA and Font fixes however, which are included in the now-live build on the main/default branch of the game.

As always, thank you for your support of Silly Polly Beast! For those who've supported the game elsewhere, the patch is currently being tested on consoles, and will be available there once certified by platforms.
If you enjoyed the game and would like to discuss it further or have a faster way of leaving feedback, feel free to join on Discord!
Developer's Discord: https://discord.gg/NTCSrmCNcn
Publisher's Discord: https://discord.gg/yy7javF

releases.displayName: New Patch Now Available on Main

items.text: Hello everyone!

Thank you for your continued support of Silly Polly Beast. We just rolled out a new patch today which addresses some miscellaneous remaining issues and concerns which trail from the prior patch from last week. As a quick note, don't be confused by the "1.0" - this is internal versioning and does not refer to the actual version of the game relative to release candidate. As a note to those who have supported the game elsewhere, this patch will also be rolled out on consoles within the next day or two.
You can find the changelog below.
Mrs. Smith's speed has been rebalanced in the Episode 5 boss fight.
Player can now deflect grenades back at enemies.
Several location fixes in Episodes 2, 3 and 5, preventing softlock situations and possible geometry issues
Small chance to get B-ammo drop from the random box.
Fixed font clipping/cut-off with non-Latin characters for long text strings
Fixed a bug where the player couldn’t scroll through phone messages using a gamepad
Fixed the "red tint issue" on certain displays using HDR & YUV422/Non-RGB color formats
TAA-related Shader Fixes
Fixes to one shader causing an issue on some displays

As mentioned in our last post, we will continue to keep an eye out for player feedback and continue to improve the user experience. This patch has been rolled out to sync both the main and beta branches, so this patch is now out on both.

Also, as mentioned prior, we have archived older, pre-balancing builds rather than getting rid of them for those who prefer certain builds. In case you missed it from the last post, the initial release variant of the game can be still accessed via branch password "archivedbuilds" (no quotes). For those who prefer the pre-balance changes of the game, we want to ensure these builds were still accessible. Note we cannot back-patch issues such as TAA and Font fixes however, which are included in the now-live build on main & beta.
Thank you again for the support on the title everyone! It means a lot to us and we hope you continue to enjoy Silly Polly Beast!

releases.displayName: Patch Now Available on Main + Other Branch Information

items.text: Hi everyone,
Happy to say that based on player feedback from our past two beta updates, we have migrated the beta patch onto the main branch. Here is the full changelog (partially mirrored from past beta posts):
Rebalanced ammo/health loot and introduced balanced mechanics (in easy/normal mode) for engagement in battle vs replenishments
Reduced cost of healing items
Enemies now alert before throwing a stone,
Bullet barrels no longer automatically extinguish at the start of a battle — only if bullets are collected
Balancing to ensure soft-lock situations are eliminated, particularly lacking health during boss battles
New boxes have been added in some locations that can, algorithmically, contain items
Hard mode remains unchanged, without additional rebalancing or mechanical changes
Frequency of loot and scaling better balanced for easy and normal mode
Better normal mode scaling
Tweaks to enemy AI
Tweaks to player stamina
Additional tweaks to balancing based on player feedback
Additional fixes for possible soft-lock scenarios
Fixes for edge-case soft-lock conditions
Improved P90 shot sound
Slightly tweaked throwing rock model scale
Fixed non-TAA antialiasing flashing screen,
Fixed several cases that blocked the game's progress,
Fixed minimum text size for non-Latin & non-Cyrillic fonts causing cut-offs in some areas
Spikes no longer attack the player if loot is on them
Additional graphical fixes

As we roll out this patch, we will continue to keep an eye out for player feedback and continue to improve the user experience. We will keep up the beta branch as well (although as of this post, it is identical to main) - any short term future balancing fixes will first go to beta for feedback before being mirrored on main.

Also, we are archiving older builds rather than getting rid of them for those who prefer certain builds. The initial release variant of the game can be still accessed via branch password "archivedbuilds" (no quotes). For those who prefer the pre-balance changes of the game, we want to ensure these builds were still accessible. Note we cannot back-patch issues such as TAA and Font fixes however, which are included in the now-live build on main & beta.
Thank you again for the support on the title everyone! It means a lot to us and we hope you continue to enjoy Silly Polly Beast!

items.text: Hi everyone!

We've heard your feedback and and are currently working on addressing common points of feedback as well as bug reports which have come in during the post-release period. We're looking forward to rolling out this upcoming update, but want to ensure balancing is in the right place. After all, we do not want to overcorrect - our concern is smoothing the experience of the game rather than wholly changing it.

Since we'd like to do a bit more internal testing ourselves as well, we figured we would roll out this update on a branch in the meantime for public feedback ahead of this being rolled out definitively. We figure it will be a few more days before this will be wholly public on the main branch.
You can access the beta branch with password "wantacracker" (be sure to remove quotes). This will give you access to the current balancing-in-progress version.
Remember - this current patch is a WIP! Changes present in this version are not final.
Here's our changelog for this update, and what to expect in the build:
Rebalanced ammo/health loot and introduced balanced mechanics (in easy/normal mode) for engagement in battle vs replenishments
Reduced cost of healing items
Enemies now alert before throwing a stone,
Bullet barrels no longer automatically extinguish at the start of a battle — only if bullets are collected
Balancing to ensure soft-lock situations are eliminated, particularly lacking health during boss battles
New boxes have been added in some locations that can, algorithmically, contain items
Hard mode remains unchanged, without additional rebalancing or mechanical changes
Frequency of loot and scaling better balanced for easy and normal mode
Better normal mode scaling
Tweaks to enemy AI
Tweaks to player stamina
Improved P90 shot sound
Slightly tweaked throwing rock model scale
Fixed non-TAA antialiasing flashing screen,
Fixed several cases that blocked the game's progress,
Fixed minimum text size for non-Latin & non-Cyrillic fonts causing cut-offs in some areas
Spikes no longer attack the player if loot is on them

Please be sure to leave feedback (either in comments here or on the forums) with feedback on this update. Our goal is to provide a definitive middleground to address valid critique without overcorrecting and removing difficulty altogether. Most changes address difficulty in easy and normal modes specifically.
There is also the game's publisher's Discord for reporting feedback: https://discord.gg/yy7javF
We hope you all enjoy and thank you again for supporting Silly Polly Beast!
Hi everyone,

There's been a quick hotfix to address the issue where a shader acted incorrectly upon throwing a larva when TAA was disabled. The shader should now act correctly regardless of TAA setting. No other changes have been made in this patch.
